review_finding: The first fix ignored the name in the language used for identity review. Such a name may contain a physical variant (for example incline); unchanged description alone cannot establish continuity.
corrected_policy: The identity-locator translation name and description both remain in the comparison against the original reviewed raw record. Changes to other-language labels, aliases, media and timestamps remain presentation changes. Equipment/variation and other identity fields must also agree.
test_revision: The previous translation_name positive case was overly broad because it renamed the reviewed-language source title. It is retained in the first historical test receipt; the current positive case changes the non-reviewed Chinese translation, while a new identity_name negative case changes the reviewed-language title and must require review. No old test/evaluation receipt was overwritten.
limitations: A newly installed snapshot lacking the originally reviewed source bytes still requires identity review.
This change grants no scientific or professional approval.
Frozen snapshots, local/private databases, offline ZIPs and earlier evidence were not regenerated.
